# acousticbrainz

The goal of acousticbrainz is to provide a dataset on musical features
of songs. This dataset was wrangled for use in the [Hello Data
Science](https://hellodata.science/) textbook to learn clustering
methods. Documentation for this package is a work in progress.

## Installation

You can install the development version of acousticbrainz from
[GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("hellodata-science/acousticbrainz")
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`acoustic_brainz`](https://hellodata-science.github.io/acousticbrainz/reference/acoustic_brainz.md)
  : Music recordings and acoustic features
